claim: In the fiscal Q2 period of 2025, Walmart reported $7.9B of operating income.
summary: Walmart's fiscal Q2 2025 (quarter ended July 31, 2024) GAAP operating income was approximately $7.9B, matching the claim.

sub_claims.text: Walmart's fiscal Q2 2025 refers to the quarter ended July 31, 2024, reported in August 2024.
sub_claims.stated_text: In the fiscal Q2 period of 2025
sub_claims.note: Walmart FY ends Jan 31; FY2025 Q2 is May-July 2024 period reported Aug 2024. Knowledge establishes this reporting period exists.

sub_claims.text: Walmart reported operating income of $7.9B for fiscal Q2 2025.
sub_claims.note: Recalled Q2 FY2025 results reported ~$7.9B GAAP operating income, up ~8.5% YoY, consistent with rounded $7.9B figure.
